verdict.rationale: Notte documents a REST API reference (Bearer-token auth, agent-start endpoint), but the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file is machine-readable documentation for agents, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
